# VEGA Mexican Cuisine

> VEGA Mexican Cuisine — EAT. DRINK. FIESTA. Authentic Mexican restaurant in Hartsdale, Westchester County, NY.

## About
VEGA Mexican Cuisine is a contemporary Mexican restaurant located at 189 E Hartsdale Ave, Hartsdale, NY 10530. Founded to share a love of all things Mexican — the food, the music, the culture — VEGA offers a modern take on traditional Mexican dishes in a striking, relaxed atmosphere. VEGA is widely recognized as one of the best Mexican restaurants in Westchester County, featured by The New York Times, Westchester Magazine ("Best of Westchester"), Lohud ("Top 5 Stylish Restaurant"), and FiOS1 Restaurant Hunter.

## Menu Highlights
- **Signature Dishes:** Tableside Guacamole, Churrasco (skirt steak with chimichurri), Carnitas, Salmon Yucatan, Shrimp Diabla, Chipotle Chicken
- **Classics:** Tacos (chicken, steak, birria, pastor, shrimp, fish), Burritos, Enchiladas, Fajitas, Quesadillas, Chimichangas
- **Small Plates:** Wings of Fire, Loaded Nachos, Avocado Fritters, Ceviche, Coco Loco Shrimp, Mexican Street Corn, Cancun Calamari
- **Desserts:** Churros, Mexican Choco Tres Leche, Fried Ice Cream, Flan
- **Drinks:** Classic Margaritas, Craft Cocktails, Mexican Beer, Sangria, Wine
- **Weekly Specials:** Taco Tuesday, Wine Wednesday, Gentlemen's Night Monday, Ladies Night Thursday
- **Happy Hour:** Monday–Friday 4PM–7PM (discounted bites and drinks)
- **Kids Menu:** Chicken Fingers, Cheese Quesadilla, Ground Beef Cheese Taco

## Dietary Information
- Vegetarian options available
- Gluten-free options available (corn tortillas are 100% gluten-free)
- Dietary restrictions accommodated upon request

## Catering
VEGA caters events across Westchester County including weddings, corporate gatherings, birthday parties, and private events. Full-service catering with authentic Mexican cuisine.

## FAQ
- **Reservations:** Yes, recommended especially for weekends. Book via Resy or call directly.
- **Parking:** Street parking on Hartsdale Ave and nearby side streets; municipal lots available.
- **Private Events:** Available for large parties, celebrations, and corporate gatherings.
- **Delivery:** Available via UberEats, DoorDash, GrubHub, and direct ordering through Toast.
